# <span id="aanchor2"></span> Arranging and Customizing Tiles

The quick launch tiles can be arranged on the dashboard in any order. Simply drag and drop a tile into a new location. While you are moving the tile, it will display as semi-transparent.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 386;height: 222;" />

Arrange tiles starting at the top left corner and working your way down, two columns at a time.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 377;height: 434;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Groups">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Tile Groups</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Groups">

Groups are denoted by increased space between tiles or tools.

<div class="procedure">

To create a new group of tiles or tools:

1.  Click the desired tile or tool and drag it to an open area on the right side of the dashboard. This will create a new group area where other items can be added.
2.  Add more items to the group as needed.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 453;height: 245;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Size">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Tile Size</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Size">

Reducing tile size increases available dashboard space.

<div class="procedure">

To change the size of a tile:

1.  Right-click a tile.
2.  Hover over **Size**.
3.  Select the appropriate option.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 358;height: 140;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Color">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Tile Color</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Color">

Tiles and widgets can be color-coded to denote priority or data groupings.

<div class="procedure">

To change a tile color:

1.  Right-click the tile.
2.  Hover over **Color**.
3.  Select the desired color.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 347;height: 164;" />

</div>

</div>

</div>
